subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should bundled ClickClack discussions remain a supported optional product surface after the required lifecycle and authorization fixes, or should this integration instead stay outside the bundled plugin?
rationale: The branch adds a new persisted configuration mode, external managed-channel lifecycle, and scoped session-access contract; code fixes can address the identified defects, but accepting the bundled product surface is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed bundled integration
options.body: Keep the feature in the ClickClack plugin after the lifecycle, read-scope, pending-create, and proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Route to an external plugin
options.body: Keep the generic discussion seam and move ClickClack-specific managed-channel behavior to an independently released plugin if bundled support is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed bundled integration
recommendation.body: Keep the feature in the ClickClack plugin after the lifecycle, read-scope, pending-create, and proof gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the adjacent generic discussion seam and is the strongest history-based owner for the proposed ClickClack implementation.
